body: Good morning sir, abeg any update on my application? I don dey wait since two weeks o.
Hello, please I wan reschedule my interview to next week, I get exam on Wednesday.
Pls how I fit upload my CV? The site no dey work for me.
Good day, wetin be the salary range for this role? Thank you o.
Kindly do the needful and update me on the status of my application at the earliest.
Dear sir, I humbly request for the interview to be rescheduled as I have a family function next week. Thanking you.
Una dey waste my time! Four weeks now and nobody tell me anything. This na disrespect.
Which kain wahala be this? Una cancel my interview again, na so una dey do candidates?
